shortDescription: Gather information about notes in Splunk Enterprise Security

options.name: api_app
options.description: The app portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment uses a different app name.

options.name: api_namespace
options.description: The namespace portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment uses a different namespace.

options.name: api_user
options.description: The user portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment requires a different user context.

options.name: finding_ref_id
options.description: The reference ID of the finding to query notes from. Required when C(target_type=finding). Format is typically C(uuid@@notable@@time{timestamp}). The C(notable_time) query parameter is automatically extracted from this ID.

options.name: investigation_ref_id
options.description: The investigation UUID. Required when C(target_type=investigation) or C(target_type=response_plan_task).

options.name: limit
options.description: Maximum number of notes to return. Defaults to 100 if not specified. Ignored when C(note_id) is provided.

options.name: note_id
options.description: The ID of a specific note to retrieve. If specified, returns only the note with this ID. For C(response_plan_task), this enables direct API lookup. For C(finding) and C(investigation), notes are fetched and filtered by ID.

options.name: phase_id
options.description: The ID of the phase containing the task. Required when C(target_type=response_plan_task).

options.name: response_plan_id
options.description: The ID of the applied response plan. Required when C(target_type=response_plan_task).

options.name: target_type
options.description: The type of object to query notes from. Use C(finding) to query notes from a security finding. Use C(investigation) to query notes from an investigation. Use C(response_plan_task) to query notes from a task within an applied response plan.

options.name: task_id
options.description: The ID of the task to query notes from. Required when C(target_type=response_plan_task).
